name: Tsunami ESCAPE 🌊
desc:
🌊 A MASSIVE TSUNAMI is coming... Can you escape?

Welcome to Escape The Mega TSUNAMI! 🏃‍♂️
A fast-paced survival obby where you must run, climb, and dodge obstacles to avoid the rising wave of doom! 💥

🔥 How to Play:
• Wait in the lobby for the next wave 🌊
• Run through parkour stages 🧱
• Climb trees, cars, and buildings to stay above the water! 🧗
• Reach the end to WIN! 🏆

💡 Every tsunami is different – use skill and timing to survive!
👥 Play solo or with friends!
👍 Like the game for updates and new maps!
⭐ Favorite to escape again later!

📌 Join our group for updates, rewards, and more:
